description: This file implements the ActiveRequests class and its nested ActiveRequestsData class, managing media segment requests, including adding segments, retrieving request types, erasing requests, and handling segments within a media pipeline server context.

classes.name: ActiveRequests
classes.description: Manages active media segment requests, allowing insertion, removal, and retrieval of segments and request types.

classes.name: ActiveRequestsData
classes.description: Holds data for a specific media request, including segments, type, and byte count.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::insert
methods.description: Inserts a new media request with specified source type and maximum media bytes, returning a unique request ID.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::getType
methods.description: Retrieves the media source type for a given request ID.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::erase
methods.description: Removes a request by its ID.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::erase
methods.description: Removes all requests matching a specific media source type.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to a specific request by ID.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::getSegments
methods.description: Retrieves all segments associated with a specific request ID.
